info.title: Genesis Mesh Trust Gateway
info.description: Operator-controlled Genesis Mesh trust verification. HTTP 200 is not a trust grant; inspect trusted in each decision.

200.description: Public domains, active directed treaties and explicitly published memberships. Cached for 20 seconds; unavailable authorities are marked.

get.description: Tokens of policy clients marked demo: true. The gateway refuses to start if a demo client can forward operator operations, read metrics, exceed 120 requests per minute or use groups other than reads and verification.

post.description: Create a persisted invite token for a pre-authorized node. Upstream: /admin/invite
Publish and activate a signed policy version. Upstream: /admin/policy

get.description: Return persisted policy versions. Upstream: /admin/policy/history

post.description: Activate a previously persisted policy version. Upstream: /admin/policy/rollback
Revoke an issued certificate and publish a new signed CRL. Upstream: /admin/revoke
Switch an operator key off without restarting the service (F-21). Upstream: /admin/operator-keys/{key_id}/revoke
Build and sign a CapabilityOffer as the NA sovereign. Upstream: /admin/agreements/offer
Build and sign a CapabilityCounter in response to an existing offer. Upstream: /admin/agreements/counter
Accept an offer or counter-offer, producing a signed AgreementRecord. Upstream: /admin/agreements/accept
Verify a signed AgreementRecord without storing it. Upstream: /agreements/verify
Issue a signed membership attestation for a subject. Upstream: /admin/attestations
Revoke an issued membership attestation. Upstream: /admin/attestations/{attestation_id}/revoke
Persist the local recognition policy used by attestation verification. Upstream: /admin/recognition-policy

get.description: Return the active local recognition policy, if configured. Upstream: /recognition-policy
Return a persisted membership attestation by ID. Upstream: /attestations/{attestation_id}
List membership attestations to operators; count them for anyone else. Upstream: /attestations
Publish this sovereign's signed feed of revoked membership attestations. Upstream: /sovereign-revocation-feed

post.description: Verify a membership attestation against a local recognition policy. Upstream: /attestations/verify
Evaluate a ContextRecord against an AgreementRecord and sign the decision. Upstream: /admin/boundary/decide
Verify a signed BoundaryDecision. Upstream: /boundary/verify
Validate policy intent against the trusted registry without signing it. Upstream: /admin/boundary-policies/validate
Validate, sign and store a new inactive policy version. Upstream: /admin/boundary-policies

get.description: List every stored boundary policy version. Upstream: /admin/boundary-policies
Return the active policy set, its health, and the enforcement mode. Upstream: /admin/boundary-policies/active
Return every stored version of one policy, newest first. Upstream: /admin/boundary-policies/{policy_id}/history

post.description: Activate a version (re-verified first); also the rollback path. Upstream: /admin/boundary-policies/{policy_id}/activate
Deactivate an active version. Upstream: /admin/boundary-policies/{policy_id}/deactivate
Policy-aware evaluation under an agreement or (v0.58.1) an attestation basis. Upstream: /admin/boundary/evaluate
Verify a signed BoundaryPolicy against the NA key or supplied issuer keys. Upstream: /boundary-policies/verify
Cast a ValidatorVote signed by the NA as validator. Upstream: /admin/consensus/vote
Assemble a ConsensusProof from votes, signed by the NA as assembler. Upstream: /admin/consensus/proof
Verify a ConsensusProof signature and threshold. Upstream: /consensus/verify

get.description: Return the active signed certificate revocation list. Upstream: /crl

post.description: Create and sign a DataLicensePolicy as licensor (NA). Upstream: /admin/data-usage/policy
Create and sign a DataAccessIntent as agent (NA). Upstream: /admin/data-usage/intent

get.description: Return the currently active DataLicensePolicy. Upstream: /data-usage/policy

post.description: Verify a DataAccessIntent against a DataLicensePolicy. Upstream: /data-usage/verify
Commit to a list of capabilities under an AgreementRecord, signed by the NA. Upstream: /admin/disclosure/commit
Issue a one-time nullifier for a capability membership proof, signed by the NA. Upstream: /admin/disclosure/nullifier
Generate a Merkle membership proof from caller-supplied data (no NA state used). Upstream: /disclosure/prove
Verify a CapabilityMembershipProof against its commitment. Upstream: /disclosure/verify
Register or refresh a signed AgentDescriptor. Upstream: /agents

get.description: Discover agents by capability. The unfiltered form returns counts only. Upstream: /agents
Return one registration. Upstream: /agents/{node_public_key}

delete.description: Voluntary deregistration. Requires a signed envelope. Upstream: /agents/{node_public_key}

post.description: Issue a join certificate using a persisted invite token. Upstream: /join
Receive a signed heartbeat from an enrolled node. Upstream: /heartbeat
Renew a node certificate while preserving server-side roles. Upstream: /renew
Sign a TrustEvidence record from a TrustDecision. Upstream: /admin/trust-evidence
Verify a TrustEvidence signature and optional graph digest. Upstream: /trust-evidence/verify
Validate and store one signed ExecutionEvidence record. Upstream: /evidence/execution

get.description: Search stored entries by vendor, attestation, capability, resource, outcome or time. Upstream: /admin/evidence
Store mode, size, last store sequence and latest retention checkpoint. Upstream: /admin/evidence/status
Verify every stored entry, chain and signature. Upstream: /admin/evidence/verify
Full history of one resource, decision to execution, with verification. Upstream: /admin/evidence/resources/{resource_id}
The head of one resource chain: what the next record must link to. Upstream: /admin/evidence/resource-heads/{resource_id}
A vendor's decisions and the evidence under them, with verification. Upstream: /admin/evidence/vendors/{vendor_id}
gm.evidence.event JSON Lines from since_sequence, for SIEM pipelines. Upstream: /admin/evidence/export
Registered executor keys (public keys; retired keys included). Upstream: /admin/evidence/executor-keys

post.description: Register a controller's executor signing key. Upstream: /admin/evidence/executor-keys
Retire an executor key: it verifies old records and signs no new ones. Upstream: /admin/evidence/executor-keys/{key_id}/retire

get.description: Signed store anchors in order, for auditors to keep outside the NA. Upstream: /admin/evidence/anchors

post.description: Sign the store's current head now (idempotent while it is unchanged). Upstream: /admin/evidence/anchors
Remove a verifiable prefix of old entries behind a signed checkpoint. Upstream: /admin/evidence/retention/apply

get.description: Return legacy health metadata plus boundary policy health (v0.58). Upstream: /health
Readiness for load balancers: database writable at the expected schema, Upstream: /readyz
Return the active node count; the full roster requires operator auth. Upstream: /nodes

post.description: Admit one signed observation (judged at admission unless that is turned off). Upstream: /evidence/observations
Admit up to 100 observations in order of their change times; one result each. Upstream: /evidence/observations/batch
Admit one signed break-glass record (judged at admission unless that is turned off). Upstream: /evidence/break-glass
Judge an observation once; returns the existing judgement when it is already judged. Upstream: /admin/evidence/observations/{observation_id}/judge
Judge a break-glass record once; returns the existing judgement when it is already judged. Upstream: /admin/evidence/break-glass/{break_glass_id}/judge

get.description: Every change to a resource: how it was governed and its state. Upstream: /admin/evidence/changes/{resource_id}
Operator key holders as the evidence store records them. Upstream: /admin/evidence/operator-holders

post.description: Propose a new holder for an operator key; another holder approves it. Upstream: /admin/operator-keys/{key_id}/holder
Approve a holder change with a privileged key of a different holder. Upstream: /admin/operator-keys/holder-changes/{proposal_id}/approve

get.description: Return machine-readable dashboard state. Upstream: /dashboard.json
Return machine-readable Atlas summary with graph digest. Upstream: /atlas.json
Return the genesis block. Upstream: /genesis
Return operator-safe public metadata for this sovereign. Upstream: /sovereign.json
Return the active signed policy manifest. Upstream: /policy

post.description: Issue a signed direct-recognition treaty for another sovereign. Upstream: /admin/recognition-treaties
Revoke a locally issued or imported recognition treaty. Upstream: /admin/recognition-treaties/{treaty_id}/revoke

get.description: Return a persisted recognition treaty by ID. Upstream: /recognition-treaties/{treaty_id}
List persisted recognition treaties. Upstream: /recognition-treaties

post.description: Verify a signed recognition treaty. Upstream: /recognition-treaties/verify
Verify a membership attestation using a recognition treaty. Upstream: /attestations/verify-with-treaty
Import a signed revocation feed from a recognized sovereign. Upstream: /admin/sovereign-revocation-feeds/import

get.description: Export minimal sovereign recognition graph data. Upstream: /recognition-graph
Return an operator-facing Connectome view as JSON. Upstream: /connectome.json
Explain whether one sovereign currently recognizes another. Upstream: /connectome/trust-path
